claims.says: On a single-label scan whose node properties are Null, Int or String, for the supported filter shapes, the index-scan rewrite selects exactly the nodes the original filter over the label scan does.
On a well-formed graph, the node-by-id seek built from WHERE id(n) comparisons returns exactly the nodes the plain id filter over an all-node scan keeps, for every kind of operand.
Whenever the greedy hop-ordering loop succeeds, the reordered and reoriented hop chain tests exactly the same edges as the original pattern's hops taken together.
For a monotone predicate, the binary search first_id_where returns the least point of the half-open range where the predicate holds, or the range's upper end if it holds nowhere.
